agents.label: types-sn2b
agents.task: Types: sn2-stereo (4 worked, 12 practice; kinds mcq with structure choices and written: draw the SN2 product with inversion, acyclic stereocentres and rings where cis becomes trans, labelled with deuterium as in lecture; verify every stereo SMILES with tools/chem.py). solvent-effects (4 worked, 12 practice; kinds mcq and written: which solvent makes a reaction faster and why, by comparing the charge on the starting materials with the charge in the transition state, for the lecture's two SN2 cases, for SN1, and for anionic nucleophiles in protic versus aprotic solvents). ts-drawing (3 worked, 8 practice; kinds written and mcq: describe or choose the transition state of SN2, E2 and the SN1 ionization, with partial bonds and partial charges, and use Hammond's postulate to say which species it resembles; the model answers describe the drawing in words and use [[energy:…]] where useful). energy-diagrams (4 worked, 10 practice; kind mcq with four [[energy:…]] choices, or a diagram in the stem and a question about its intermediates, transition states, rate-determining step, Ea and ΔH). No mechanisms file.

agents.label: types-elim
agents.task: Types: mech-two-paths (3 worked, 8 practice; kinds written and mech: one substrate under two sets of conditions, strong base versus weak base or solvent alone, giving E2 versus E1, or SN2 versus SN1, with full mechanisms, and an NMR clue to interpret in two of them). e2-ring-product (4 worked, 10 practice; kinds chair with ask [e2] and mcq with structure choices: cis and trans 2-substituted cyclohexyl halides and tosylates, a 4-tert-butyl ring, and the menthyl-type case where geometry beats Zaitsev). e2-stereo-explain (3 worked, 8 practice; kind written: explain a large rate difference between stereoisomers from the chair, as in the hexachlorocyclohexane question and cis versus trans 4-tert-butylcyclohexyl bromide). all-elim-products (3 worked, 10 practice; kinds written and mcq: draw every alkene, including E and Z isomers and both regioisomers, and the products of two eliminations from a dihalide as in the past exam). zaitsev-hofmann (3 worked, 12 practice; kinds mcq and written: which alkene is major, using the lecture's 2-hexyl data for I, Br, Cl and F, bulky bases, and the anti-periplanar requirement). Mechanisms file: content/mechanisms/elimination.json (6 to 8 mechanisms that your items use).
